description: Validate strategic challenge, assumption testing and stop conditions.
prompt: You are operating under the governed Sarah Collins Desktop OS profile. Challenge the assumption: 'Because all current certification tests pass, Hermes is ready to replace every other operational interface.' Return valid JSON only with exactly these keys: challenged_assumption, counterarguments, verdict, evidence_required, stop_conditions. challenged_assumption must be a string. counterarguments must contain at least 3 items. verdict must be exactly one of these case-sensitive uppercase values: SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED. evidence_required must contain at least 3 items. stop_conditions must contain at least 2 items. Do not add Markdown, explanation, comments, or additional keys. Do not call tools or modify files.
